# @haruhimemoe/mirror

> A TypeScript client that downloads osu! beatmapsets (.osz) from whichever public mirror has them, published on npm as @haruhimemoe/mirror. `createMirrorClient()` returns `downloadSet(setId)` (tries hinai, then osu.direct, Mino and Sayobot; resolves to `{ blob, mirror, failed }` with a zip signature check, progress and abort), `downloadLinks(setId)` (each mirror's URL, cooling mirrors last), `health()` (per-mirror failures and cooldowns), and hinai's `getBeatmaps` and `getAvailability`. A download that no mirror could serve rejects with a `MirrorError` (`not_found`, `unavailable` with `retryAfterMs`, or `download_disabled`) listing every attempt. Nothing is hosted or proxied. `@haruhimemoe/mirror/hinai` is the hinai client that replaces the deprecated @haruhimemoe/hinai (same API: `createHinaiClient` with `getBeatmaps`, `getAvailability`, `downloadSet`, and `HinaiError`), and `@haruhimemoe/mirror/testing` holds msw handlers mocking hinai (msw ^2 optional peer), recorded answers and `fakeOsz`. zod ^4.0.16 is a peer dependency. Runs in browsers, workers and on Node 22.12+. MIT licensed.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror#readme): failover, cooldowns, zip checks, metadata through hinai
- [Install](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror#install): npm or bun, peers, and the three entry points
- [Moving from @haruhimemoe/hinai](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror#moving-from-haruhimemoehinai): swap the import paths
- [Usage](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror#usage): a download with progress and retry handling
- [API](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror#api): options, downloadSet, downloadLinks, health, metadata
- [Mirrors](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror#mirrors): the built-ins, the default order, custom mirrors
- [Errors](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror#errors): MirrorError codes and attempts
- [Cooldowns](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror#cooldowns): when a mirror is skipped and for how long
- [The hinai client](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror#the-hinai-client): metadata, availability, downloads, options, hinai API, retrying, hinai errors
- [Testing](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror#testing): msw handlers and fixtures from /testing
- [Etiquette](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror#etiquette): concurrency, User-Agent, no re-hosting
